title: cytisus pilosus
intro: Cytisus pilosus, commonly known as Scotch broom, is a flowering plant species in the family Fabaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support cardiovascular health and act as an antioxidant, helping to protect the body from free radicals. The therapeutic actions of Cytisus pilosus include its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce swelling and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
